$comment: Approved-component registry TEMPLATE for /create-flow. Copy to the designer-approved registry path before use. This is an approval manifest, not a second source of truth: Figma file ymEnGYUGvRRVKhHiUSGMVF remains authoritative. Never fill a field with a guessed value — leave it empty and list it under `unverified`.

_fieldGuide.id: Stable registry ID, e.g. 'ds.button'. Never reuse an ID for a different component.
_fieldGuide.status: One of: proposed | approved | deprecated | blocked. Only 'approved' may be placed in new flows.
_fieldGuide.assetType: 'component_set' or 'component', exactly as returned by search_design_system.
_fieldGuide.componentSetKey / componentKey: Import key copied verbatim from a scoped search_design_system result. Empty if not observed.
_fieldGuide.sourceNodeId: Main component / component-set node ID in the source file (e.g. '5681:4769'). Empty until confirmed.
_fieldGuide.identityLink: How key and sourceNodeId were linked: 'designer-confirmed' | 'unverified'. No read-only tool returns both together.
_fieldGuide.identityEvidence: Plain-language evidence for the key/node relationship (e.g. 'imported set has 28/28 variant names identical to source node 66:1419'). Evidence is not proof: identityLink stays 'unverified' until the designer confirms.
_fieldGuide.variantCount: Number of variants in the imported set (set.children.length). Lets /create-flow detect that not every axis combination exists.
_fieldGuide.verification: { capabilityTest, PASS: [...], UNVERIFIED: [...] } — what a recorded capability test actually exercised for this entry. Never list anything under PASS that was not exercised.
_fieldGuide.libraryUpdatedAt: The asset's updatedAt from search_design_system at inspection time.
_fieldGuide.inspectedAt: ISO timestamp of the read-only inspection (get_metadata / get_design_context / get_variable_defs / get_screenshot).
_fieldGuide.variants: Map of VARIANT property name → list of approved values (exact source spelling), a subset of variantOptions. Omit values the designer did not approve. An EMPTY map approves NO variants — it never means 'all allowed'.
_fieldGuide.states / sizes / modes: Allowed states, sizes, and variable modes (e.g. Light/Dark) for this entry.
_fieldGuide.properties: Approved non-variant component properties, each as { key, type, allowed }. `key` is the EXACT Figma key read from componentPropertyDefinitions of the set imported into the target, including the #id suffix and any special characters (e.g. 'Label#2022:15', 'Left ⤵︎#27:0', 'Show Icon#7056:0'). Never use get_design_context names such as 'label' or 'showIcon'. type: TEXT | BOOLEAN | INSTANCE_SWAP. allowed: values or 'any text'. If a needed property does not exist (e.g. Badge has no TEXT property), record it under `limitations`, not here.
_fieldGuide.variantCombinations: Optional. Exact variant names (e.g. 'Property=primary, Size=Medium, State=Default') the designer approved. When present and non-empty, the full variant name of a placed instance must be in this list, in addition to every axis value being in `variants`. Use it whenever the approved combinations are not the full cross-product of the approved axis values.
_fieldGuide.nestedDependencies: Optional. Map of variant name → list of built-in nested instances that are approved only as unchanged internal dependencies of that variant, each { sourceId, name, key, variant, visibility, mustRemainHidden, provenance }. `sourceId` is the layer path inside the instance (e.g. '4166:2597;2073:2043'), read from linked instances in the target. Placed instances must match the list exactly (same key and variant name, no overrides, listed hidden dependencies stay hidden). Add entries only from verified read-back evidence.
_fieldGuide.slots: Optional. Map of variant name → list of SLOT rules, each { slot, name, defaultContent, allowReplacement, allowedContent, minChildren, maxChildren }. `slot` is the stable layer path of the SLOT inside the instance (its ID without the 'I<instance>;' prefix, e.g. '7000:3166;7000:3114'); never use the IDs of slot children, which are file-local. `defaultContent` is the ordered list { key, variant } of the library's default children, read from untouched linked instances in the target. `allowReplacement: false` means the default content must stay unchanged. `allowedContent` lists registry IDs whose approved variants and properties may replace it. The host's componentProperties override caused by an allowed slot edit is not treated as a nested override.
_fieldGuide.variantOptions: Full option list per VARIANT axis as read from the imported set (variantOptions), e.g. size: [x-small, small, medium, large]. `variants` (approved values) must be a subset of this.
_fieldGuide.fonts: Fonts the component's text uses, observed when loading them before placement (e.g. Noto Sans Georgian Medium). Required for rule 9.
_fieldGuide.limitations: Capabilities the component does not expose (e.g. 'no TEXT property — label cannot be overridden'). These are reported as UNVERIFIED/gaps; working around them by detaching or editing internal layers needs explicit designer approval.
_fieldGuide.instanceSwapAllowed: For INSTANCE_SWAP slots: list of registry IDs allowed as swap targets.
_fieldGuide.nestedContent: Permitted nested-content usage (e.g. slot accepts list-item only).
_fieldGuide.requiredBindings: Variables/styles the component uses INTERNALLY (name + key) — evidence from get_variable_defs. Informational: the component carries these bindings itself. Unknown keys are UNVERIFIED notes and never block an otherwise approved component or any other verified functionality.
_fieldGuide.variableSetKey / collectionModes: Variables only: the collection key from search_design_system and the mode names actually read from that collection (e.g. Light, Dark). Leave collectionModes empty if not read directly for this variable.
_fieldGuide.approvedUsage: Variables and styles: the exact usages that were tested AND approved, each { nodeType, property, [layoutMode], evidence }, e.g. { nodeType: 'FRAME', property: 'fills' } or { nodeType: 'FRAME', layoutMode: 'VERTICAL', property: 'itemSpacing' }. Declared `scopes` describe what Figma allows; `approvedUsage` is what /create-flow may do. Any binding not listed here is rejected, even if the scope would allow it. Empty = no usage approved.
_fieldGuide.usageRestrictions: Free text: where/how this may or may not be used.
_fieldGuide.approval: { by, quote, at, scope } — the designer's actual words and what they cover. Empty means NOT approved.
_fieldGuide.replacedBy: For deprecated entries: registry ID of the approved replacement (requires its own approval).
_fieldGuide.unverified: List of fields/claims not yet backed by evidence.
_fieldGuide.layoutSchemaVersion: Top level, since r8: version of the layout governance fields (currently 1). Shape and rules: design-governance/layout-governance.schema.json, checked by design-governance/scripts/validate-registry.mjs.
_fieldGuide.layout: Optional, since r8: sizing rule for one approved component, from a recorded layout capability test. { status: proposed | approved | blocked, nativeByVariant: { '<variant>': { horizontal: HUG | FIXED, vertical: HUG | FIXED, width, height } } (verified native sizing; width/height only for FIXED axes), horizontal: { allowed: ['NATIVE', 'FILL'] } (must include NATIVE), vertical: { allowed: ['NATIVE'] } (always), fill: { variantCombinations (only tested variants), contexts: [{ id, parentType: FRAME, parentLayoutMode: VERTICAL, parentLayoutWrap: NO_WRAP, parentCounterAxisAlignItems, childLayoutPositioning: AUTO, testedInnerWidth: { min, max }, evidence }], extraOverrideFields (own-override fields FILL adds, e.g. primaryAxisSizingMode) }, verification: { capabilityTest, PASS, UNVERIFIED }, approval } — approval is null unless status is 'approved', which requires { by, quote, at, scope }. No entry, or a status other than 'approved', allows NATIVE only. There are no arbitrary widths or heights.
_fieldGuide.contentConstraints: Optional, since r8: component-specific text limits found by testing — line and container rules, never character counts. [{ id: 'C-…', property (exact TEXT key), textLayerByVariant: { '<variant>': '<layer path>' | null }, containerLayerByVariant (optional, same shape), kind: SINGLE_LINE | MAX_LINES | FIT_CONTAINER, maxLines (integer for MAX_LINES, else null), onViolation: VISUAL_DEFECT | UNVERIFIED, status: verified-limitation | unverified, dsIssue: 'DS-NN' | null (design-governance/design-system-issues.md), evidence }]. A null layer path is UNVERIFIED in the audit.
_fieldGuide._blocking: Blocking for use in a flow: status/approval, key match + freshness (libraryUpdatedAt), approved variants/properties, variant-combination existence, identityLink only if the designer requires node-level proof. Non-blocking (reported as UNVERIFIED): requiredBindings keys, sourceNodeId, fonts of variants not yet exercised (they are loaded and checked at placement time), collectionModes not read directly.

exampleShapes.$comment: Shapes only — every value is a placeholder in angle brackets. Do not copy these placeholders into real entries.
